items.title: Vampire Pouring Tea
items.alt: A smiling adult vampire with a short burgundy cape pours tea from a round pot into a cup on a tiny tray, one hand per object.
items.description: A smiling adult vampire with a short burgundy cape pours tea from a round pot into a cup on a tiny tray, one hand per object. Useful for personal party invitations.

items.title: Vampire Delivering a Moon Letter

items.description: A friendly vampire courier in a navy cape holds a sealed crescent-stamped envelope beside a small satchel. Useful for seasonal correspondence labels.
